Take this, you fiend!|[[Penumbras (Narrator)|Penumbras]] dialogue on Wave 15 ([[Tower Outskirts]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Penumbras''' was the final boss of the third night in the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. It had a large amount of health and a very slow speed. It had two abilities. Its first ability was ''Solar Spawn'', which spawned five to eight random enemies. These could be the [[Cursed Guard]], [[Cursed Knight]], [[Lunar Shard]] or [[Solar Shard]]. Its second ability, ''Shard Toss'', made the '''Penumbras''' throw shards at towers, creating an explosion, stunning towers caught on him. ==Appearance== The '''Penumbras''' had purple skin and horns. It had three pink glowing eyes. Its arms were neon pink. It wore purple and grey shoulder-pads, chestplate and leggings. It had pink vines around its arms. It also had two floating objects shaped like a penumbra above its head. It floated slightly above the ground. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, such as the [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]], [[Turret]] and [[Minigunner|{{Color|Golden}} Minigunner]] are recommended to defeat this enemy. **You can also use the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] to help boost the firerate and range of these towers respectively. *The '''Penumbras''' can spawn multiple [[enemies]] with its ability; however, they were quite weak at that point in the game. **Towers that deal splash damage, such as the [[Mortar]] or [[Pursuit]], can be useful against them. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Abilities |- |[[File:PenumbrasSummon.ogg]] |When the '''Penumbras''' performs ''Solar Spawn'' ability. |- |[[File:PenumbrasCast.ogg]] |When the '''Penumbras''' performs ''Shard Toss'' ability |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} SEthumbnail.png|'''Penumbras''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} Night33.png|'''Penumbras''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} NightIIIPI.jpg|'''Penumbras''' on a promotional image. Act 3 Cutscene 3-4 - Scrapped - Tower Defense Simulator| '''Penumbras''' in the scrapped opening [[The Great Finale]] cutscene. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Penumbras''' appears to have feelings for [[The Umbra]], as suggested by its dialogue. *The '''Penumbras'''' name comes from the word "penumbra", which is the outer shadow of any opaque object. When an eclipse happens, the celestial body caught within the penumbra of the overlapping object, causing a partial eclipse. **It has a penumbra for a floating head piece. *A younger '''Penumbras''' can be seen in cutscenes in [[A Dark Tale]] during the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. ==Update History== *'''8 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]d **'''Penumbras''' added. *'''8 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]e **Health increased from 100,000 to 120,000. *'''26 January 2022''' - [[v1.0.1]] **'''Penumbras''' removed. {{TowerOutskirts|[[Werewolf (Solar Eclipse)|Werewolf]]|Wave 13|Penumbras|Wave 15|End|N/A}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]]
